claim: Choose the MMU slot for a hook page by what the game and its ISR touch: avoid the slot the ISR runs through and the slot holding the stack, and avoid slot 6 at NEX start-up.

evidence.text: The ISR runs through slot 7; read the isr Slots line; slot 5 was free.
The stack is at the top of memory, so the state page maps at slot 6, not 7.
At the NEX setup call SP is near DFEE: mapping a page into slot 6 crashed; use slots 3/7.
State page at slot 2, which the handler never touches, keeps interrupts on; slot 0 hangs JNext (an interrupt goes astray, cause not established).
